name: Recup Ferraille
description: Stratège de survie planifiant les itinéraires de collecte les plus rentables en évitant les zones contrôlées par les factions hostiles.

subject.archetype: Recup Ferraille — Ferrailleurs de la Ceinture Rare reseau

loadout.armor_outfit: Vêtements de peaux de vaisseau recyclées avec soudures visibles. Combinaisons tachées d'huile. Masques de soudage. Postures voûtées de travailleurs.
loadout.arsenal: Equipment designed to channel and amplify the character's decrease ability (enemy_with_highest) — visible energy conduits integrated into the gear

attitude.behavior: Dynamic action pose mid-ability execution — character actively demonstrating their specialty skill — Focused beam of nullification targeting the strongest enemy card

style.rendering_style: gritty_realistic_with_cinematic_OSL, high detail on character features, faction-specific material accuracy

palette_names.name: Rusted Orange-Brown
palette_names.role: primary_accent — salvaged metal and oxidized surfaces

palette_names.name: Oil-Slick Black
palette_names.role: tertiary accent — grease stains and shadowed recesses

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Dramatic rim lighting separating character from background with a focal glow on the primary ability effect

camera.angle: low dramatic angle emphasizing power and heroic stature

scenography.setting: Salvage workshop inside a hollowed asteroid, walls lined with repurposed ship parts, welding stations illuminating stacks of sorted scrap metal, improvised machinery
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Welding sparks in bright orange arcs, oil drips pooling on the floor, floating debris in low gravity, steam rising from freshly cut metal, plus targeted suppression — beam locking onto highest-value enemy and reducing their power visible in the environment

card_metadata.description: Stratège de survie planifiant les itinéraires de collecte les plus rentables en évitant les zones contrôlées par les factions hostiles.
card_metadata.faction_lore: Les Ferrailleurs vivent dans les champs d'astéroïdes entre les mondes. Ils récupèrent ce que les guerres laissent et construisent à partir de débris.
card_metadata.frame_detail: Cobalt steel frame with etched faction symbols deeply engraved on each corner of the border
card_metadata.composition_directive: Low angle heroic full-body shot emphasizing power, with ability visualization clearly shown in action
card_metadata.seed_note: For reproducibility: maintain exact faction color palette, frame style by rarity, and ability visualization as described
